user.title: Select connection type
user.description: Pick how the Modbus master is reached. A serial port always speaks RTU, a TCP gateway speaks Modbus TCP or RTU over TCP.

tcp.title: Configure TCP connection
tcp.description: The host and port of the Modbus gateway. The frame format must match the gateway, Modbus TCP is the default and RTU over TCP is for serial to ethernet gateways.

serial_pick.title: Select serial port
serial_pick.description: The ports are detected on the system running Home Assistant. Choose a device or enter the path manually.

serial_manual.title: Serial device path
serial_manual.description: The device path as Home Assistant sees it, for example /dev/ttyUSB0, /dev/ttyS0 or COM3. In Docker the host device has to be mapped into the container.

serial_params.title: Serial port settings
serial_params.description: These must match the device. The defaults are 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity and one stop bit.

slave.title: Modbus slave address
slave.description: The unit ID of the device on this connection, 10 is 0x0A. The coil count is the number of coils the device has, a 32 channel module uses 32. More slaves can be added later on the page of this integration. Add several slaves at once, the addresses follow the address above.

error.invalid_host: Enter a valid host name or IP address
error.invalid_serial_path: Enter a valid serial device path
error.no_slaves: Add at least one slave address
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect, check the serial settings or the slave address
error.serial_port_busy: Another program holds this serial port, the bytes would be split between them. Please pick another port.

user.title: Add a Modbus slave
user.description: The unit ID of a device on this connection, 10 is 0x0A. The coil count is the number of coils the device has, a 32 channel module uses 32. Add several slaves at once, the addresses follow the address above.

error.slave_already_added: This slave address is already used on this connection

user.title: Add a wall panel bus
user.description: The serial line the panels are connected to, together with their brand. The brand decides which protocol is used to read the buttons and to drive the indicator lights. Pick the port from the list or type a path, a port that this integration already uses is not in the list. The feedback frame is the report frame 0x04 of the protocol document, change it to the set frame 0x03 when the light of the panel stays dark. Note: a panel usually uses codes of its own for the state it reports, the integration learns and keeps them from the frames of the panel. Fill them in here when the codes of the panel cannot be learned.

data_description.led_on_code: Optional. The code that is written into the frame to turn an indicator light on. It applies to every button on this bus. Leave it empty to let the integration learn the code from the frames the panel reports, when no code is learned it uses 1 (0x01).
data_description.led_off_code: Optional. The code that is written into the frame to turn an indicator light off. It applies to every button on this bus. Leave it empty to let the integration learn the code from the frames the panel reports, when no code is learned it uses 0 (0x00).

user.title: Link a panel button to a relay
user.description: Pick the buttons of the wall panels and the relays of the Modbus slaves. The state is shared in both directions: a button drives the relays, a relay lights up the buttons. The upper picker only shows the panel buttons, the lower one only the relays. In the switch mode the light of the panel follows the state of the relay. In the scene mode the relay only triggers a scene once, the light of the panel answers the press and is not switched off again by the relay falling back.

reconfigure.description: Pick the buttons of the wall panels and the relays of the Modbus slaves. The state is shared in both directions: a button drives the relays, a relay lights up the buttons. init.title: Symi Modbus Options
init.description: The time one round over all slaves takes. Every slave of the connection is asked once per round, so the interval between two slaves is the scan interval divided by the number of slaves.

write_coil.name: Write coil
write_coil.description: Write a coil value to a Modbus device.

hub.name: Hub
hub.description: Entry title shown in Settings. Leave empty when only one connection is configured.

write_register.name: Write register
write_register.description: Write a register value. Not supported by this device profile.
